entities.summary: Liebfrauenkirche is a Gothic-style Catholic parish church, located in the centre of Frankfurt, Germany. It was built in several phases from the 14th to the 16th century and serves today as a monastery church. Close to the shopping district, it serves as a place of rest even to visitors who are not religious. With an organ completed in 2008, it is a major venue for church music events. Liebfrauen, Frankfurt is a church building in Europe, established in 1301. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
